t: There is no church here now. St Michael-le-Querne, also called St Michael ad Bladum, was a parish church in Farringdon Within Ward. It was destroyed in the Great Fire of London in 1666 and was never rebuilt. The name seems to refer to a quern-stone, because there was a corn market in the churchyard. John Leland, the English poet and antiquary, is buried here. He lived from 1502 to 1552. So this is a spot where a lost church and a writer's burial both survive only as history.
